Briar Knight (CV 21)

A fey guardian enclosed in barklike armor, with a thorn-grown shield and a long spear. A living blossom at the shoulder marks the promise it serves.

Attributes: Brawn +2; Fortitude +1; Agility +1; Guile +1; Knowledge +0; Reason +1

HP: 22 · Speed: 6 · Size: 1 (medium) · Armor DR: 2

Evasion: None · Threat: 1 Bane · Stability: 0

Weaknesses: None\ Resistances: Physical (2)\ Immunities: None

Actions

Damage and effects are Weak / Standard / Strong player defense. Each slash separates one complete outcome. All attacks use the printed Threat unless stated otherwise.

Main ActionsDefenseDamage
Basic MeleeAgility5/3/2

ManeuversEffect

Opportunity AttackBasic Melee

Details

Briar spear

The blow lands with enough force to send its victim stumbling backward.

Target: One creature within 2 squares. Player defense: Agility. Damage type: physical.

Weak defense: Push 2. Standard defense: Push 1.

Shield Hunker

Before a shield-blockable attack resolves, impose 1 Bane on player attacks this shield can block until the start of its next turn. The DA judges blockability. Uses its Reaction; stacks with Defend, not another activation of itself.

Barbed Recoil

The struck bough bends back, dragging a rake of hooked thorns across the hand that struck it.

After an adjacent attacker's attack resolves and deals HP damage to this creature, apply Bleeding 1 to that attacker. This creature must survive and remain capable. No trigger from a free attack or another retaliatory effect. This is a condition, not another attack.

General details

Basic Melee: One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

Defend: Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

Opportunity Attack: Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

Healing: Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

Senses: Ordinary sight and hearing.

Signs: A path through brambles remains exactly one traveler wide.

Purpose: Keep an old promise attached to a road or bridge.

Tactics and retreat: Shield Hunker at the crossing, push trespassers back, and insist on terms.

Counterplay and conversation: Read the promise literally; fulfilling it may be easier than defeating its keeper.

Habitat: Forest crossing · Communication: Common and Fey

Loot: An oath token and ordinary thorn-carved equipment that withers if summoned.

Summoning: Fey 3 — @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.da-rules.JournalEntry.45cc6c04dbd3a1f2.JournalEntryPage.838354317fa1385f]{player reference}.

Design notes — not needed during play

ID: creature-briar-knight

Category: Fey · Role: Defender · CV: 21

Difficulty rationale: No innate attack modifier; armor, cover and chosen actions provide its defenses. Its dangerous attack imposes defense Banes.

Reference damage: 3/4/6

Reference type: physical

Expected targets: 1

Utility factor: 1.35

Action review (#1279): U 1.2 → 1.35: Maneuver allowance +0, Reaction allowance +0.15. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

Regeneration per turn: 0

Reference I=3.000, O=3.653. CV uses the seed worksheet; action choices, Stability and control are not simulated. Recalibration remains required.
